name: electron-blocks
description: Timeblocks desktop shell — loads the react-web-calendar build in the main process

scripts.sync:web: npm --prefix ../react-web-calendar run build:dev && rm -rf web-build && cp -R ../react-web-calendar/build web-build
scripts.build: npm run compile && npm run sync:web && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --x64 && electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.build:mac: npm run compile && npm run sync:web && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --x64
scripts.build:win: npm run compile && npm run sync:web && electron-builder --win --x64
